component-o.description-s: Nano-Fit vertical header, single row, 2 circuits, 2.50 mm pitch, through hole with PCB peg, gold (0.76 um), 8.0 A per contact, 250 V, -40~115 C, for 1.6-2.4 mm boards. Battery link: 1 BAT+, 2 GND. Mates with Nano-Fit receptacle 105307 / OTS harness 45130-02xx.

connector-o.board_area_note_s: courtyard plus the on-board part of the mate keepout

mate-o.frame_s: the board connector's footprint frame; the model is built there, so offset and rotation are zero
mate-o.source_s: Molex SD-105309-100 (header), SD-105307-100 (receptacle 15.70 long, 5.85 into the header), 45130 harness 20 AWG; keepout adds 2.5 mm on the latch side (-x) for the release finger; mated receptacle height estimated from the drawings

connector-o.source_s: Molex SD-105309-100 (header), SD-105307-100 (receptacle 15.70 long, 5.85 into the header), 45130 harness 20 AWG; keepout adds 2.5 mm on the latch side (-x) for the release finger; mated receptacle height estimated from the drawings
connector-o.current_note_s: 6.5 A per contact is the 45130 OTS harness rating at 20 AWG (Molex 45130-0203); the gold header alone is rated 8.0 A
